description: This Java class 'DefaultHealthCheckConfig' provides the default implementation of the Gateway health check configuration, including methods to instantiate, access properties, and override equality and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Implements the default configuration for Gateway health checks, including timeout, basic health check, and cluster roles settings.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultHealthCheckConfig from a Config object, applying fallback and default configurations.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured service timeout duration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the health check is enabled based on the basic health check configuration.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for health checks.
